title: Earnings-revision ranking (learning to rank)
description: Rank stocks each month on fundamental revision signals (3-month change in TTM EPS growth, revenue-growth acceleration) plus momentum and value; LightGBM LambdaRank by date.
question: factors
method_note: There are no analyst-consensus revisions in the Studio catalog, so the revision signal is a fundamental proxy: the 3-month change in point-in-time TTM EPS growth (it moves when a new filing arrives). LambdaRank optimizes NDCG of return grades within each date; scored by rank IC and top-minus-bottom quintile spread. Caveat: the universe is today's constituents (membership history starts 2026-10), so early years carry survivorship bias; read the premium as an upper bound.

result.verdict: LambdaRank does not significantly beat pointwise LightGBM on rank IC (DM p = 0.379)
